audit: qa/clipping-audit.js, run in the page at ?qa
knownLimits: Sampled at 30 fps, so a contact shorter than one frame could be missed.
Guests are tested against the set, not against each other.
Contacts under 3 cm are treated as resting contact.
Feet can still slide briefly at sharp turns and step transitions.
The fastest arm movement, 41 rad/s at 2.27 s, happens underwater after entry.
